command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes'; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1).output.Split('#'); `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2).output.Split('#'); `$d=Compare-Object `$b `$a | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -notmatch 'Last configuration|Command.*not found' }; if(`$d){ Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n.name); `$d | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } }"
